timeline.body: Since the cancellation of task is not immediately effective, is it possible that there will be two tasks calling nextPullOffset method in the same period of time. For example, two tasks A (cancelled) and B (newly generated), If A task calls nextPullOffset method first, seekoffset will be - 1, and then A task a will be cancelled. Because of seekoffset is - 1 the seek operation will not take effect in B task.
